data.title: 罗丝薇瑟 · 卧室微醺的女武神求婚献身
data.description: 散发着甜腻酒香的昏暗卧室内，深蓝真丝睡裙从雪白香肩彻底滑落。眼泛泪光、满面娇红的罗丝薇瑟跨坐在你身上，颤抖着搂紧你的脖颈，断断续续地喘息着“今晚……就把我变成你真正的新娘吧”。
data.location: dim warm bedroom with ruffled bedsheets
data.action: straddling partner on bed with flushed face and teary eyes, unbuttoned nightgown slipping down shoulders, begging with trembling lips to make her a bride tonight
data.lighting: dim bedside amber lamp casting deep warm shadows on bare curves
data.mood: passionate drunken surrender, desperate marriage craving, heated lover intimacy
data.promptProse: Straddling partner on bed with nightgown sliding off bare shoulders, flushed Rossweisse begs for marriage with teary eyes and passionate breathless kisses.
data.animaCaption: Rossweisse straddling partner on bed with teary eyes and bare shoulders.
